description: Quantum Data Technologies Limited, formerly Chakwal Spinning Mills Limited, is a technology company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange that has moved into IT and allied services. It describes itself as a data- and AI-driven technology company, and its website covers a digital payment platform and super app alongside data-centre services. In October 2026 it disclosed a framework agreement with China's Guangzhou Great Power to introduce and progressively undertake local assembly of lithium-based battery energy storage systems in Pakistan.
headOffice: Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: The company's own PSX disclosure of 14 October 2026 (dps.psx.com.pk) for the registered office, telephone and website, and its website qdtech.io for the leadership and service description, read 2026-10-17. The website's marketing statistics are not repeated here.
